settings.intro: Please sign in, read the agreement, and sign it below. You'll be emailed a signed copy.

fields.content:
Volunteer agreement

Replace this text with your agreement. Keep it here, in the form, so the exact words are part of each signed record.

  • I will follow the site's safety rules.
  • I will tell a coordinator if I can't make a shift.

esign.disclosure: You can ask for a paper copy of this agreement at any time. You can withdraw your consent to electronic records by contacting us; that doesn't undo signatures already made. You'll need a PDF reader to open the signed copy we email you.

config.text: Signed. Your signed copy is on its way to your email.
